purpose: Canonical governance record for product and release claims. It distinguishes release-metadata facts, positioning, external research, unvalidated hypotheses, and prohibited claims.

claims.claim: v{version} registers {coreTools} core tools; the default profile exposes {defaultProfileTools}; an authenticated compatible UXP host can add {uxpAdditionalTools} capability-gated tools for a {defaultProfileWithUxpTools}-tool connected surface. The release also declares {toolModules} modules, {resources} MCP resources, and {guidedWorkflows} workflow prompts.
claims.boundary: Catalog and packaging facts do not prove that an individual Premiere operation works on a live host.

claims.claim: The release targets Premiere Pro {premiereVersions}; UXP workflows require a compatible Premiere Pro {uxpMinimumVersion}+ host and advertised capabilities.
claims.boundary: Compatibility, CI, package validation, local build, and HTTP health are not real-host proof.

claims.claim: Reviewable workflow automation for Adobe Premiere Pro.
claims.boundary: Use 'designed for reviewable workflows'; do not use 'production-proven' until a published licensed-host test matrix supports the specific workflow.

claims.claim: A design-partner program at $499–$1,500 per team for 60 days and a Pro companion at $19–$29 per month are validation hypotheses.
claims.boundary: No paid plan, checkout, revenue, or customer commitment is claimed. Do not publish as an offer without a separate commercial decision.

claims.claim: Adobe AI Assistant is a public beta that overlaps with media organization, footage preparation, and initial-assembly workflows.
claims.boundary: Position the product as complementary and evolving; do not claim general superiority over Adobe AI Assistant.

prohibitedUntilEvidenceExists: Current Adobe Marketplace approval or publication
Real licensed-host proof for an untested workflow
Approved testimonials, customer logos, adoption, activation, retention, conversion, revenue, or time-saved results
Live deployment state inferred from repository artifacts, CI, or local checks
Universal Premiere compatibility or guaranteed editing outcomes

maintenance.whenReleaseMetadataChanges: Update release-metadata.json first, then resolve the template claims and affected public surfaces in the same change.
maintenance.whenExternalResearchChanges: Update reviewedOn, source, wording, and boundaries; do not turn an external fact into a product claim without evidence.
maintenance.whenCommercialDecisionChanges: Replace a hypothesis only after the offer, pricing, terms, billing, and support scope are approved and published.
maintenance.validation: tests/claims-registry.test.ts validates the metadata relationship, the marketing-context rendering, pricing labeling, and known stale marketing claims.
